stem: Which statement about eosinophilic oesophagitis is correct?

options.text: Eosinophilic oesophagitis is more common in males than females
Eosinophilic oesophagitis is more common in females than males
Eosinophilic oesophagitis affects males and females equally
Eosinophilic oesophagitis occurs only in adolescent females
Sex distribution is not described for eosinophilic oesophagitis

explanation: Eosinophilic oesophagitis is more common in males than females, so option A is correct.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because eosinophilic oesophagitis has a male predominance.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because eosinophilic oesophagitis is more common in males than females, not the reverse.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the sex distribution is not equal; male predominance is more typical.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because eosinophilic oesophagitis is not limited to adolescent females.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the sex distribution is described as male predominant.
